source_of_truth: this file; `cargo xtask fast` checks the deploy profiles against it
description: The deployment profiles an Aseman node runs in, the ports each service listens on, who may reach them, and the certificates and tokens each side presents. One Aseman node is one federation identity in every profile: adding a worker or losing a replica never changes it (ADR 0013).

compact.summary: One machine. One Aseman control replica, one Nomad server that is also a client, one PostgreSQL, one VMM, one backend.
compact.singleton_work: the one replica still takes the coordination lease, so a compact deployment that later grows never has to change how singleton work is fenced
compact.suitable_for: development, a single-tenant node, and evaluation

cluster.summary: Several Aseman control replicas behind one stable endpoint, three or five Nomad servers, an expandable worker pool, and external or HA PostgreSQL.
cluster.aseman_replicas: 3 or more, across failure domains; PostgreSQL owns state, so the count needs no quorum
cluster.nomad_clients: 1 or more, added and removed without touching Aseman identity
cluster.singleton_work: one fenced `CoordinationPort` lease per named job (ADR 0013)

host.summary: Worker agents and Nomad clients installed on the host, for machines where a container cannot safely be given KVM or network capabilities.
host.reason: Firecracker needs /dev/kvm, tap devices, and cgroup control; these stay on the host and out of every other service (ADR 0010)

aseman-node.role: the Aseman API and control plane

ports.name: api
ports.reachable_by: users and federated nodes, through the stable endpoint

ports.name: guest
ports.reachable_by: workloads, from the worker network only

ports.name: health
ports.reachable_by: the load balancer and the operator

aseman-node.presents: the node's TLS certificate for the stable endpoint
aseman-node.verifies: user sessions, A401 proofs, and workload credentials
aseman-node.privileges: none: no KVM, no docker socket, no host mounts

aseman-vmm.presents: a server certificate from the VMM CA
aseman-vmm.verifies: the calling node's client certificate; the certificate's SHA-256 is the owner every record is scoped by
aseman-vmm.privileges: none: it schedules, it does not run workloads

ports.name: a504
ports.reachable_by: the VMM service on the same host only

aseman-vmm-backend.presents: nothing: the listener is refused on a non-loopback address
aseman-vmm-backend.privileges: the native backend needs the docker socket; the Nomad backend needs only a namespace-scoped Nomad token

ports.name: agent
ports.reachable_by: the VMM backend on the same host only

aseman-vmm-agent.presents: a host certificate from the VMM CA
aseman-vmm-agent.verifies: a signed, short-lived operation naming one allocation
aseman-vmm-agent.privileges: /dev/kvm, tap devices, cgroups, the jailer, and its own allocation root — nothing else

nomad-server.verifies: mutual TLS between servers and clients, and ACL tokens on the HTTP API

ports.name: http
ports.reachable_by: the Nomad backend, for allocation logs, stats, and files

nomad-client.privileges: the docker socket and CNI; it is never given the Aseman database or the node's keys

postgres.role: all authoritative Aseman state, including the VMM's

ports.name: sql
ports.reachable_by: the Aseman node and the VMM service only

postgres.verifies: a role per creature for guest data; the control roles are separate
postgres.privileges: workers and workloads never reach it: guest data is reached only through the node's signed guest API (ADR 0001)

nomad_backend_token.reason: a stolen backend token must not be able to reconfigure the cluster or read another namespace's jobs

workload.nomad_identity: proves which allocation is calling; authorizes no Aseman operation
workload.aseman_credential: the workload's Ed25519 credential, which every guest-API call is signed with (A405)

certificates.node_endpoint: the stable public endpoint's certificate; replicas share it, so replica identity is never published
certificates.vmm_ca: issues the VMM's server certificate and the node's client certificate; the VMM admits exactly the node certificates its configuration lists
certificates.nomad_ca: the operator's, separate from the VMM CA: a compromise of one does not admit the other
certificates.rotation: every certificate is rotated without restarting the node, and a rotation never changes the Aseman node ID or its signing-key lineage (ADR 0009, ADR 0013)

identity.node_id: one node ID and one node signing-key lineage in authoritative capsule state
invariants: adding or removing a worker does not change the node ID
losing or replacing a control replica does not change the node ID
changing the VMM backend does not change the node ID
a replica address is never published as node identity

ordering.comment: The order a profile is brought up in, and the order it is migrated in.
ordering.migration: the Phase 3 storage cutover, then the VMM rollout, then the VMM handoff, then the new node (ADR 0030): a remote VMM is refused under the legacy storage provider
